core_rule: Husk is waste. Kernel is food. Never depict intact husks eaten like chips.

steps.instruction: Put one in-shell sunflower seed between the teeth.
steps.evidence: Visible placement; fingers partly obscure the seed.

steps.instruction: Use a small bite to crack the husk.
steps.evidence: Visible seed and husk movement at the teeth.

steps.instruction: Use tongue and teeth to separate kernel and husk inside the mouth.
steps.evidence: Internal action is narrated; only subtle external mouth movement is visible.

steps.instruction: Bring the husk to the lips and spit it out. Keep and eat only the kernel.
steps.evidence: Spitting gesture visible and identified by narration. Tiny ejected fragment contents are unresolved.

alternative: Manual removal of the husk at the lips replaces spitting; it is not an extra sequential step.
shell_collection: Husks go into a shell bag; this is HUBB usage guidance, not shown in the tutorial.

motion.name: Edited whole sequence
motion.method: Forward source excerpts concatenated; crack 1.5x slower, spit 2x slower; not a single uninterrupted cycle.

packages.use: Open one sealed sachet to snack.
Sell sachets individually. Same-flavour case assumed.
packages.image_limit: Display styling reference only; not a verified 24-unit carton.

packages.use: Open lid, take one sealed sachet; keep remaining sachets sealed.
Collect discarded husks only; never put them back into the food sachet or cup.

artwork_rule: Preserve the supplied cream-and-brush packaging artwork exactly. These are design references.
llm_use: Read written rules. Inspect linked stills and GIF/video only if supported. Do not claim to have watched media from text or metadata alone.
